Japan's Anthropic Usage Index is **1.91** for the period starting 2026-05-01. That ranks it **32nd of 121** countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the world's working-age population. A value of 1.0 is the global average, so Japan's usage is about 91% higher than its population alone would predict.

- **Work, personal and coursework use:** 47% / 47% / 6% in Japan, against 43% / 40% / 16% worldwide.
- **Augmentation vs. automation:** 53% / 47%, against 51% / 49% worldwide.
- **Top job category:** Computer and Mathematical, at 23% of conversations (24% worldwide).

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
